_what: The rules of the share inbox (ported from the earlier code base src/share-inbox.mjs at b6ae0ebf815f and its records/share-inbox.json): what a share waits in when the person's store cannot answer, how long it waits, how often it is tried again, when it gives up and the words the person reads. Read by read-data/share-inbox-rules.mjs only. The storage that holds what waits is not chosen here (see README: owner ruling).
kept_words: Kept. It will be delivered as soon as your account answers.
too_big_words: This is too big to hold until your account can take it. Send it again later.
gave_up_reason: your account did not answer for a long time
